name: discover/breadcrumb
title: DiscoverBreadcrumb
summary: The trail above one item's page on a Discover site: a named <nav> with an ordered list of crumbs, the last the current page (aria-current="page"), and the same trail as BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

props.name: crumbs
props.description: The trail, from the service's home to the current page. The last crumb is the current page and is never a link; its href (if any) is its URL in the JSON-LD.

props.name: origin
props.description: The site's origin, e.g. "https://events.mukoko.com", that makes relative hrefs absolute in the JSON-LD. Without it, the request's origin.

props.name: jsonLd
props.description: Emit the BreadcrumbList JSON-LD. Pass false when the page's DiscoverMeta already carries one.

behaviour: A <nav> named "Breadcrumb" holding an <ol>; separators are aria-hidden text.
The last crumb is the current page: plain text with aria-current="page", never a link, even when it has an href.
A crumb before it with no href is plain muted text.

The BreadcrumbList JSON-LD comes from the same `crumbs`: `position` from 1, `name`, and `item` as an absolute URL (relative hrefs resolve against `origin`, else the request's origin; the current page uses its href, else the request path; a crumb with no href and not current has no `item`). `<` is escaped so the data can never close its element. JSON-LD is data, not script.

relative.description: No origin and no href on the current page: both come from the request.

nojsonld.description: The page's DiscoverMeta carries the BreadcrumbList.

keyboard: Tab reaches each crumb link in order; the current page is not a stop.
aria: The nav is labelled "Breadcrumb"; the current crumb has aria-current="page"; the separators are aria-hidden.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML; its JSON-LD is data (`type="application/ld+json"`), not script.

responsive: The trail wraps onto more lines when narrow; it never scrolls sideways.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-breadcrumb"
  label is "Breadcrumb"
  a "Harare" min_height 24
  when default shows span "Jacaranda Music Festival"
  when default shows a "Events"
  when relative shows span "Running"
  when nojsonld shows a "News"
end

checks.say: A named nav and an ordered list.
The current page is marked, once.
The current page is not a link.
Relative hrefs are absolute in the JSON-LD.
The current page's own href is its URL.
Without an origin or an href, the request gives the current page's URL.
jsonLd false leaves the data out.
